name: serpapi_youtube
description: Fetch YouTube video details through SerpApi using a YouTube URL or video_id, with optional transcript lookup through SerpApi's YouTube transcript engine. Useful fallback when yt-dlp is blocked by cookies, auth, or missing transcript issues.

url.description: YouTube watch, short, embed, or youtu.be URL.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID. Use this instead of url when you already know the ID.

gl.description: Optional country code for YouTube localization, like us or gb.

hl.description: Optional UI language for video details. Default: en.

language_code.description: Transcript language code for transcript lookup. Default: en.

transcript_title.description: Optional transcript title to select a specific transcript variant.

transcript_type.description: Optional transcript type, such as asr for auto-generated transcript.

include_transcript.description: If true, fetch transcript details through SerpApi when available. Default: true.

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

extra_params.description: Additional SerpApi YouTube video parameters passed through, excluding reserved keys.

include_raw.description: If true, include the raw SerpApi payload in data.raw.
